zh-Hans: 支持再次点击同一文件的快速预览关闭 Quick Look
关闭设置后自动清理无更新和检查失败等临时结果
精简已是最新版本的结果展示，同时保留需要处理的新版本信息
en: Click the same file's Quick Look action again to close its preview
Clear transient up-to-date and failed check results when Settings closes
Simplify up-to-date feedback while retaining updates that still need attention
